verdict.rationale: AMD's marketing highlights creator workloads (DaVinci Resolve, 3D rendering) and tunable power via PBO, and independent reviews broadly call the chip 'energy efficient' with 'strong productivity performance,' but none of the evidence gives documented power envelope specs or dedicated long-render/export sustained perf-per-watt testing.  missing for 10: explicit TDP/power envelope documentation, independent sustained-load (render/export) thermal-throttle or perf-per-watt benchmarks.
